title: Ball moved by an animal
question: A dog runs onto the fairway and knocks your ball out of its spot. According to the rules, what should you do?

choices.text: Play the ball from its new spot
Add a penalty and replace the ball

explanation: If an outside influence, such as an animal, moves your ball at rest, you must replace it without penalty.
imagePrompt: A teenage left-handed girl looks surprised as a dog knocks her resting golf ball on a sunny fairway.
imageAlt: Teen left-handed girl on the fairway, watching a dog move her resting golf ball.

issues: The golfer's stance is not overtly right-handed; it's a generally neutral surprised stance, but this is minor as she is not holding a club.
No club is present, as correctly specified.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Ensure the teenager's surprised posture subtly but clearly suggests she is a right-handed player, even when not holding a club.
